title: Platform sync
body:
Maya: First item, summarisation latency. Priya?
Priya: p95 on Claude is 4.1 seconds, our target is 3. Same prompts on OpenAI came in at 2.2 seconds with equal quality on the golden set.
Sam: The provider abstraction is ready, so adding an OpenAI endpoint is about a week of work.
Maya: Any reason not to switch?
Elena: We have no rollback plan. If OpenAI degrades we need a trigger and a way back. Also the staging keys expire Friday.
Maya: Fair. Decision: we set up a new API endpoint for summarisation on OpenAI instead of the existing Claude one, and keep Claude as the fallback for two weeks.
Priya: I will ship the OpenAI endpoint by October 16.
Elena: I will write the rollback plan by October 10 and rotate the staging keys before Friday.
Sam: I will extend the provider timeout tests to cover OpenAI.
Marcus: Does this affect Harborline? Their summaries feed the payroll pilot.
Priya: No contract change, same response shape.
Maya: Good. Let us review progress next week.

_extraction.summary: The team decided to move the summarisation endpoint from Claude to OpenAI, keeping Claude as a two-week fallback. A rollback plan does not exist yet.
_extraction.intent: Fix summarisation latency by switching provider

help.subject: Help needed: staging key rotation and rollback for the provider switch
help.body:
Hi DevOps team,

In today's Platform sync we decided to move summarisation from Claude to OpenAI. Two things need your help:

1. The staging provider keys expire on Friday and nobody owns the rotation.
2. We have no rollback plan if the new provider degrades.

Could someone from DevOps pair with Elena Petrova this week on both? Happy to share details.

Thanks,
Maya

title: Harborline payroll discovery call
body:
Dana: Thanks for making time. I still have not seen the scope.
Marcus: That is on me. You will have it tomorrow.
Dana: For the Gulf pilot we have 400 employees. We need approved hours in our payroll system by December 1 so we can test before January.
Sam: CSV export can do that today. Your IT team asked for the API format, which is not built.
Dana: CSV is fine for the pilot. API can come later.
Maya: Then we agree: the Gulf pilot runs on CSV export, starting December 1, for 400 employees.
Dana: One warning. Our IT change freeze starts December 15, nothing goes live after that.
Marcus: I will send the scope and pricing tomorrow.
Sam: I will send your IT team the CSV field mapping by Friday.
Dana: Good. Let us meet again next week to confirm.

_extraction.summary: Harborline agreed to run the Gulf payroll pilot on CSV export for 400 employees starting December 1. Their IT change freeze starts December 15.
_extraction.intent: Agree the scope of the payroll pilot
